contacts.introTitle: Live in comfort, just like at home
contacts.introText: We create more than apartments — we create a space where everyone feels comfortable and at ease. Our service offers an individual approach to every guest, transparent rental terms, and full support throughout the stay. Booking an apartment is easy, and living in one is a pleasure: modern interiors, convenient locations, and attention to every detail make your time in Moscow truly enjoyable. We value your time and comfort, so every detail is considered — from a quick response from the manager to a home that is fully ready for your stay.
contacts.introClosing: With us, Moscow feels like home.

instructions: Choose check-in and check-out dates in the calendar

booking.title: Guest details
booking.description: Enter your name and email. Select your preferred contact method. Email will be used as a backup contact method. Your booking is confirmed only after a manager contacts you.
booking.captchaExpired: The verification code has expired. Request a new code.
booking.captchaLoadFailed: CAPTCHA could not be loaded. Refresh it and try again.
booking.whatsappNumberRequired: Enter the WhatsApp number with the country code.
booking.whatsappNumberFormat: Enter a valid WhatsApp number with the country code.
booking.telegramUsernameFormat: Enter a valid Telegram username in the format @username.
booking.guestNameTooShort: The name must contain at least 2 characters.
booking.guestNameTooLong: The name must not exceed 100 characters.
booking.guestNameControlCharacters: The name must not contain control characters.
booking.guestPhoneFormat: Use digits and the symbols +, spaces, parentheses, or hyphens.
booking.guestPhoneTooShort: The number must contain at least 7 digits.
booking.guestPhoneTooLong: The number must contain no more than 15 digits.
booking.checkInPast: The check-in date cannot be in the past.
booking.checkOutAfterCheckIn: The check-out date must be later than check-in.

booking.requestInvalid: The request could not be checked. Check the booking details and try again.

booking.requestValidationFailed: The server rejected the details. Check the booking fields.
booking.requestRateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
